subject: Orion Energy onboarding: missing ledger tag on purchase serial — provisional cap and line-item fixes
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orionenergy.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@orionenergy.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — onboarding packet attached

Hi David,

Thanks again for walking us through the onboarding checklist earlier. I attached the completed intake (onboarding_form_v3.pdf) and our initial line-item CSV. One thing our procurement platform flagged: the purchase serial your system returned for our initial test (PS-OR-00047) does not have a ledger tag associated in your ledger mapping. That blocks automated PO claims on our side.

Can you point me to the field you expect for ledger tagging? We currently push ledger tags as a two-part code (dept:project), e.g. ENERGY:GRID-23. Happy to map if you tell us the expected format.

Also — can you issue a provisional purchase code with a spend cap so we can start testing billing flows while the mapping is sorted? A short provisional cap of $5,000 would be enough for our smoke tests.

Samantha
ProcureOps, Orion Energy

--- attachments: onboarding_form_v3.pdf (pdf, 98KB), line_items_orion.csv (csv, 12KB) ---

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orionenergy.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — onboarding packet attached

Samantha — thanks for the packet and the CSV. Quick answers:

- Ledger tag: we store ledger tags on the purchase_metadata. Our canonical format is <ORG>(optional)-<DEPT>:<PROJECT> (example: ORN-ENG:GRID-2023). We can accept ENERGY:GRID-23 but will normalize to ORN-ENERGY:GRID-23 in our system.

- Purchase serial PS-OR-00047 was created during a dry-run and missed the ledger_tag due to an early ingestion bug (we pushed a fix this morning).

Immediate plan I propose:
1) I will issue a provisional purchase code (PPC-ORN-728) with a $5,000 spend cap and attach it to your intake row so your system can test automated claims.
2) Monica will run a one-off job to backfill ledger tags for any dry-run serials and reconcile PS-OR-00047.
3) Irene will validate the line-item SKU mapping (there are two SKUs in your CSV that look like legacy IDs).

Can we do the test tomorrow morning? If you confirm, I will attach the provisional code and send a follow-up with the provisional code and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
David Kim
Program Manager, Procurement Integrations
Redwood Inference

--- internal note: will create PPC-ORN-728 and backfill ledger tags; attachments: none ---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orionenergy.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — onboarding packet attached

David — I kicked off the backfill for any serials created before 2027-05-18 10:00 PDT. Summary below:
- Backfilled ledger_tag for PS-OR-00047 => ORN-ENERGY:GRID-23
- Found 4 additional dry-run serials (PS-OR-00041..44) with null ledger_tag; updated to ORN-ENERGY:GENERIC
- Noted two SKU mismatches in line_items_orion.csv:
  * orion-old-332 -> map to ORN-SKU-332A
  * orion-legacy-01 -> request confirm (Samantha)

Samantha — please confirm the mapping for orion-legacy-01. If you confirm, Irene will push the SKU remap and I will re-run the ingest verification. I will also register the provisional purchase code once David gives the go-ahead.

Monica
Vendor Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

--- attachments: backfill-report-20270518.txt (stub) ---

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orionenergy.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — onboarding packet attached

Thanks — this looks great. Confirming:
- orion-legacy-01 maps to ORN-SKU-01B
- we accept provisional purchase code PPC-ORN-728 with a $5,000 cap for test claims. Please mark that code as time-limited (expires 2027-06-01) so our procurement can reconcile against the MOA.

Next asks: can you (a) attach the temporary ledger link in the intake Drive folder and (b) send a DocuSign link for the MOA draft (we will need a signed MOA before you lift the provisional cap). I attached a redline to the MOA in this thread (signed-moa-draft.pdf).

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Once the remap goes through we will run claim tests and let you know if any ledger-edge cases appear.

Best,
Samantha
ProcureOps, Orion Energy

--- attachments: signed-moa-draft.pdf (pdf, 32KB) ---
